timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1543 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is at a 17-year weakest level (1543 KRW per USD), meaning you need significantly more won to get your $2,000. Multiple headlines describe a "strong dollar" rally that shows no signs of stopping, with forecasts suggesting the rate may test even higher levels above 1540.

TIP: Consider splitting your $2,000 monthly purchase into smaller weekly or bi-weekly chunks to average out the unfavorable rate, or wait for any temporary won-strengthening dips before converting the full amount.
